question: A student claims that, over the ranges tested, soil moisture had a greater effect on percent germination than soil temperature did. Do the data in Table 1 support this claim?

options.B: Yes; the highest value in Table 1, 92%, occurred at the middle soil-moisture level.
options.C: Yes; at 25 °C, percent germination rose from 73% to 92% as soil moisture increased from 10% to 20%.
options.D: No; germination was the same at all three soil-moisture levels at 10 °C.
